serverPolicy.duration: Quantize the community 3 seconds to 60 server ticks.
serverPolicy.draw: ceil(raw W46 drawMillis * 0.75 / 50); only a selected eligible exact base roll may activate the candidate timing.
serverPolicy.trigger: Successful precision-hit event; no kill requirement is supplied by the sources.
serverPolicy.refresh: Use one nonstacking 60-tick window refreshed on qualifying hits; deadline representation and event ordering are project policy, not source-verified details.
serverPolicy.stow: Clear on stow per community research; runtime integration belongs to the main worker.

unknowns.refreshAndStacking: The captured text does not precisely document stacking, hit-refresh ordering, death/disconnect cleanup, or server-tick expiry ordering.

sourceBoundary: Official manifest identity/socket pools establish exact selected roll eligibility and the precision-hit description.
